rows.note: Use this for a physically uneven surface with bumps, dips, or grooves; it is the all-purpose choice for that meaning.

example.english: This mountain road is uneven, so it’s hard to drive on.
example.traditional: 呢條山路凹凸不平，揸車好跣。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 saan1 lou6 nap1 dat6 bat1 ping4 zaa1 ce1 hou2 sin2

rows.note: Use this when amounts, distribution, or other features are not evenly balanced or uniform.

example.english: The portions are uneven: some people have more than they can finish, while others don’t have enough.
example.traditional: 啲餸分得唔平均，有人多到食唔晒，有人就唔夠。
example.jyutping: di1 sung3 fan1 dak1 m4 ping4 gwan1 jau5 jan4 do1 dou3 sik6 m4 saai3 jau5 jan4 zau6 m4 gau3
